name: vico
description: Root commands for the Vico monorepo

scripts.install:all: cd services/agent && uv sync && cd ../../apps/desktop && npm ci
scripts.dev: cd apps/desktop && npm run tauri dev
scripts.lint: cd services/agent && uv run ruff check app ../../tests
scripts.typecheck: cd services/agent && uv run mypy app && cd ../../apps/desktop && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust
scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && cd apps/desktop && npx tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
